answer: Personhood graph sparsity resists sybils: honest attestation networks are sparse and locally clustered, but a sybil tries to spiral many edges from few real roots, producing a telltale density anomaly where one river of trust feeds an implausibly large delta. The lagoon of fakes shows too many identities per genuine human endorsement. Capping the identities any single real root can vouch into bounds the whole sybil region to a small multiple of the honest roots it captured.
